_comments.w259v9_u10_tasksupport_audit: W259-v9 P1 U10 2026-05-16 — MCP `execution.taskSupport` audit (original scope). W392 Stream-A C1 2026-05-24: PER-SERVER list updated to reflect current 16-server roster — context7, memory, graphiti, phoenix, and gitnexus were removed from mcpServers prior to this audit update and are NO LONGER WIRED. SCOPE: `execution.taskSupport` is the MCP-spec server/tool capability declaring whether a tool may run inside CC's durable Task system (values: 'forbidden' = never in a Task; 'optional' = may run in or out of a Task; 'required' = must run inside a Task). It is an OPTIONAL per-tool annotation surfaced in `tools/list` — the MAJORITY of servers do not advertise it, in which case CC's effective default is treated as 'optional' (the tool runs as a normal tool call). PROBE METHOD: HTTP MCPs probed via curl (live-endpoint check); local-service MCPs probed via TCP port check; tool inventories observed from the live CC deferred-tool surface. No server in this file was observed to advertise an explicit `taskSupport` value in any `tools/list` response, so every row below is classed UNKNOWN — meaning: no explicit `taskSupport` declaration was observed for that server, and no explicit 'forbidden'/'required' constraint was observed. CURRENT 18-SERVER ROSTER (all UNKNOWN — no explicit taskSupport observed): (1) github [type:stdio]; read-only API tools. (2) deepwiki [type:http, REACHABLE — HTTP 406]; doc-fetch, stateless. (3) chrome-devtools [stdio]. (4) repomix [stdio]; pack/grep are batch ops, Task-friendly. (5) serena [stdio]. (6) ccusage [stdio, local]. (7) cognee [type:http; backing server 127.0.0.1:8000 — NSSM CogneeMCP LIVE per W263b; entry no longer INERT]. (8) langfuse [stdio]. (9) basic-memory [stdio, uvx-pinned 0.21.4]. (10) hf-mcp-server [type:http]. (11) perplexity [stdio]. (12) playwright [stdio]; long-running browser ops are natural Task candidates. (13) exa [stdio; ENABLED — EXA_API_KEY confirmed set per W444]. (14) firecrawl [stdio]. (15) codegraph [stdio; local SQLite knowledge graph]. (16) docling [stdio]. (17) gpt-researcher [stdio; uv-run, gpt-researcher 0.14.8 + fastmcp 3.3.1]. (18) ruflo [stdio; 215 MCP tools, agent orchestration, ruflo@3.10.1]. REMOVED SERVERS (no longer in mcpServers — refs excised): context7 (retired), memory (excised W313 Stream A), graphiti (retired W295 AI-5), phoenix (removed), gitnexus (removed). DURABLE-EXECUTION COVERAGE: 0/16 current servers were observed to declare an explicit taskSupport annotation — no MCP in this runtime imposes an observed durable-Task constraint. NO CONFIG CHANGE REQUIRED — this is an observational audit. STREAMABLE-HTTP CONFIRMATION: THREE `type:"http"` servers (github, deepwiki, cognee) — zero `type:"sse"` entries — no legacy-SSE migration needed. _comments.cognee_w259v8: W259-v8 Step 3 2026-05-16 — added `cognee` cold-tier GraphRAG memory bridge per docs/architecture/W259-grand-catalog/03-deepdive/COGNEE-INTEGRATION-CLAUDE-W259v6.md §3.2 (Option 1) + MEMORY-LAYER-RECONCILED-W259v4.md §5.2 L0-substrate. _comments.ollama_w259v15: W259-v15 2026-05-16 — Ollama backend brought up for the graphiti MCP. graphiti env OPENAI_API_URL/OPENAI_BASE_URL moved 11700 -> 16700: port 11700 is inside the Windows TCP excluded range 11619-11718 (Hyper-V/WinNAT reservation) so no process can bind it (WSAEACCES — 'an attempt was made to access a socket in a way forbidden by its access permissions'); 16700 is above the 1024-15000 dynamic range, same band as FalkorDB 16379 + Phoenix 16006. Ollama 0.24.0 reinstalled from the official winget package (Ollama.Ollama). OLLAMA_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:16700 (User-persistent env var). Advanced config per docs.ollama.com/faq: OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1, OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0, OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m, OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=2, OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=8192. Models in Z:/ollama/models: qwen3.6:35b (LLM 23GB) + qwen3-embedding:0.6b (embedder 639MB, 1024-dim). Smoke-verified on http://127.0.0.1:16700/v1 — embeddings return 1024-dim (matches EMBEDDER__DIMENSIONS=1024), chat completion finish_reason=stop. qwen3.6:35b is a reasoning model (~200 completion tokens for a trivial answer). The running graphiti MCP adopts :16700 on the next Claude Code restart (MCP server env is spawn-time). Reversibility: revert OPENAI_*_URL to 11700 + unset the OLLAMA_* User env vars.
